assets.name: mycelium
assets.method: Built-in image generation; offline Lanczos resampling, RGB BC1 mipmapped packing
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original seamless tileable albedo texture for Predator Isle's Spore Forest ground, requested square 2048 by 2048 pixels. Primary request: sparse, anatomically plausible fungal mycelium growing in irregular branching dendritic networks over dark decomposed forest soil, as in real close-up biological reference photographs. Frame represents about 2 metres of substrate, orthographic straight overhead, every part in focus, flat neutral diffuse lighting without baked directional shadows or specular highlights. About 80 percent of the visible area is exposed dark brown-black gritty organic soil with tiny decomposed plant flecks. Narrow off-white branching rhizomorphs make connected irregular root-like networks of changing thickness; each thick strand tapers and splits into finer filaments. Thin strands only occupy about 15 percent of the surface; occasional very small fuzzy hyphal junctions occupy another 5 percent. Long meandering connected strands, asymmetrical branch angles, several scales of fine offshoots. Natural restrained contrast and cream/off-white fibres, no blue or green tint. Avoid cotton wool, fuzzy carpeting, dense white mats, lace sheets, web blankets, fur, moss, grass, mushrooms, trees, isolated props, regular branching stamps, repeating loops, even spacing, a central focal pattern, vignettes, labels, watermark, borders, neon or emission. Full bleed material swatch; seamlessly tileable on all four edges. Single albedo image, not a PBR map sheet, montage, terrain render or perspective landscape.
assets.revision_note: Sparse branching network replacing fuzzy-mat appearance. Version 1 preserved. Generated edges are not assumed pixel-identical; the shader mirrors and rotates the fungal swatch to keep border color continuous.

Natural biological hierarchy, broad hard regions and restrained varied organic segmentation. Mostly dry matte, physically substantial, neither metal nor rock nor wet flesh. assets.name: membrane
assets.method: Built-in image generation; offline Lanczos resampling, RGB BC1 mipmapped packing
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless reusable square 2048x2048 albedo texture for alien biological membrane terrain in a realistic game. Orthographic directly top-down full-bleed material swatch with flat diffuse neutral lighting and no directional baked shadows. Thick stretched leathery biological membrane, dark desaturated red-brown and muted gray-maroon skin, smooth tensioned surfaces alternating with delicate irregular folds and fine fibrous attachment seams. Broad soft sheets, varied fold width and changing directions, shallow fine pores, selective subtly damp areas but mostly satin rough material rather than plastic gloss. Restrained biological horror, no gore or blood or exposed body parts. Distinct from fungal mycelium, nerve fascicles and armored carapace. Seamless all four edges, no regular waves or grid or hexagons, no random colorful noise, no neon or glow, no creatures, eyes, eggs, objects, text, logos, borders, watermark, perspective, landscape or PBR montage. Single albedo texture only.
